name: valve-write-faults
description: Inject independent acceptance-journal and actuator-audit write faults and observe the original queue receipt settle.

steps.why: devices discovered and claimed before the session, as in the release smoke

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'A840410000000003','Valve 3','STREGA_VALVE',1,id,'CLOSED','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z' FROM irrigation_zones WHERE name='Zone A';
INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'A840410000000006','Valve 6','STREGA_VALVE',1,id,'CLOSED','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z','2026-11-23T06:00:00.000Z' FROM irrigation_zones WHERE name='Zone A';
CREATE TRIGGER review_valve_fault_log BEFORE INSERT ON actuator_log WHEN NEW.deveui='A840410000000006' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'review actuator audit fault'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER review_valve_fault_accept BEFORE UPDATE OF transport_json ON valve_actuation_expectations WHEN NEW.device_eui='A840410000000003' AND json_extract(NEW.transport_json,'$.phase')='ACCEPTED' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'review acceptance journal fault'); END;
